feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Second person charged in connection with shooting of police officer in Nottingham
articles.summary: A second person has been charged in connection with the shooting of a police officer in Nottingham city centre on 18 October.

articles.title: Two men killed by falling trees - as Storm Boelo recovery under way
articles.summary: Two men have been killed by falling trees as Storm Boelo pummelled the UK, with winds of up to 84mph, flooded streets and power cut to 800,000 homes.

articles.title: Boy, 17, arrested after teenager dies in crash following police chase
articles.summary: A teenage boy has been arrested after a boy died in a crash following a police pursuit.

articles.title: Girl, 4, dies after falling from east London tower block
articles.summary: A four-year-old girl has died after falling "from height" from an east London tower block, police said.

articles.title: Two-day manhunt for escaped prisoner who is 'a risk to the public'
articles.summary: Police warned the public not to approach an escaped prisoner who has been on the run from a medical facility for two days.

articles.title: PM open to 'honest discussion' about return to EU free movement
articles.summary: Andy Burnham says that an "honest discussion" is needed about readopting the EU's free movement rules.

articles.title: Labour unveils £285m funding boost to 'shift power' to local leaders
articles.summary: Andy Burnham has announced £285m to fund local communities, declaring mayors shouldn't have to go "cap in hand to Westminster".

articles.title: Power surge at major UK airport delays hundreds of flights
articles.summary: A power surge at Stansted Airport has caused hundreds of flights to be delayed.

articles.title: Police to allow some offenders to breach curfews without arrest
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Police is reducing enforcement of offenders who breach their tag conditions amid resourcing pressures and following early prisoner release.

articles.title: Government backs bid for 'Northern Games' in 2040s
articles.summary: The prime minister is supporting plans to bring the Olympic and Paralympic Games back to the UK, with £7m cash due to be announced in next week's budget.
